specials.title: Red Dog Bar & Bistro Piney Creek Specials
specials.description:
Appetizer
Shrimp Ceviche ... 15
Shrimp - poached, diced and marinated in lime
juice with onions, tomatoes, avocados and cilantro.
Served with crispy fried tortilla chips.

Entrées
Seared Ahi Tuna Rice Bowl ... 32
Sushi-grade Ahi tuna, seared and sliced, over a
bed of seasoned rice, with steamed edamame,
carrots and creamy avocado. Garnished with
seaweed salad and pickled ginger, then drizzled
with spicy mayo dressing.

Chicken Curry ... 24
Roasted pulled chicken in a mild creamy
coconut curry sauce; served over rice.

Dessert:
Strawberry Fool ... 10
Sliced strawberries layered with lemon curd.
An old English favorite - smooth, tart and sweet.
Served with whipped cream.

LUNCH SPECIALS
Friday & Saturday 11 AM-3 PM
Grilled Chicken Salad ... 15
Grilled chicken breast, cheddar cheese, tomato, cucumber and croutons on mixed greens with your choice of dressing.

Fried Chicken/Bacon Ranch Sandwich ... 14
Buttermilk, dill pickle-brined chicken breast, battered and fried. Topped with provolone cheese, lettuce, tomato and Ranch dressing. Served on a toasted bun with fries.

specials.title: Red Dog Piney Creek Specials
specials.description:
Appetizer

Steamed Clams with White Wine, Garlic & Butter ... 16 
Garlicky, buttery steamed clams with white wine, shallots, fresh parsley and lemon juice. Served with crusty bread for soaking up the juices!

Entrées:

Linguine with Clams "in Bianco" (White Clam Sauce) ... 28
Linguine with in-shell clams, white wine, plenty of fresh garlic, lemon juice, and a hint of red pepper flakes.
OR
Linguine with Clams "in Rosso" (Red Clam Sauce) ... 28
Linguine with in-shell clams in our savory marinara sauce with white wine, garlic and fresh parsley.

Shrimp Tacos (3) ... 18
Smoky chipotle shrimp, shredded cabbage, red onion, pineapple salsa, cilantro and jalapeño cream sauce on corn tortillas.

Dessert:
Strawberry Fool ... 10
Sliced strawberries layered with lemon curd. An old English favorite - smooth, tart and sweet. Served with whipped cream.

LUNCH SPECIALS: Friday & Saturday 11 AM-3 PM

Grilled Gyro ... 15
Seasoned ground lamb, lettuce, tomato, onion, feta and Tzatziki sauce, wrapped in a warm pita.

Loaded Cheese Fries ... 14
Crispy fries, smothered in mozzarella and cheddar cheeses, topped with our housemade bacon jam and ranch dressing.
